pages.text: Nothing from the world above lives in the Hollow. What does live here is strange, mostly harmless, and worth knowing.$(br2)Their remains are $(l)materials$(): infuse them into $(l)Hollow Charms$() at the altar or in an Infuser.

pages.name: Wisp
pages.text: A drifting mote of light, curious about you. Cyan in the open Hollow, violet in the Barrens, gold in the Grove.$(br)$(l)Drops:$() Wisp Essence.

pages.name: Crystal Moth
pages.text: Wings of thin crystal. Flutters low over the Barrens and the Grove.$(br)$(l)Drops:$() Moth Wing Dust.

pages.name: Glimmerhorn
pages.text: A shy deer of the Grove with antlers of living crystal. Glow Berries draw it close, and two fed Glimmerhorns will breed.$(br)$(l)Drops:$() Antler Shards.

pages.name: Mirror Minnow
pages.text: Silver fish that school in the Mirror Sea. They cannot be caught in a bucket.

pages.name: Hollow Shade
pages.text: $(4)Hostile.$() A tall shadow that blinks closer when you keep your distance. Its touch dims your sight.$(br)$(l)Drops:$() Shade Cloth, Ender Pearls.

pages.name: Shardling
pages.text: $(4)Hostile.$() A stubborn golem of the Barrens. Arrows glance off its crystals: strike it up close.$(br)$(l)Drops:$() Amethyst.

pages.name: Mirror Lurker
pages.text: $(4)Hostile.$() A glassy eel with a glowing lure. It only hunts those in the water, and flops helplessly on land.$(br)$(l)Drops:$() Lurker Scales.
